about.summary: Fresno City College is a public community college in Fresno, California. It is part of the State Center Community College District within the California Community Colleges system. Fresno City College operates on a semester schedule and offers associate degrees and certificates.

documents.title: Definition of Terms | Fresno City College
documents.summary: The page provides definitions of various terms used in institutional research and effectiveness at Fresno City College, covering topics from accountability reporting to statistical analysis. Definitions include both specific educational concepts and general research methodologies, aiming to support data assessment and planning within the college.
